image.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: professional hairstyle-analysis teaching image for a mobile app
Primary request: Create one horizontal four-panel contact sheet showing the SAME fictional adult East Asian woman in her CURRENT chin-to-upper-neck bob from four true views: front, exact left profile, exact right profile, and back. This is a pre-service analysis image only, not a makeover, not an AI reference hairstyle, and not a proposed haircut.
Scene/backdrop: plain warm light-gray salon wall, identical neutral camera distance, lens, color balance and soft daylight in every panel.
Subject: fictional adult woman around 31, natural skin texture, calm neutral expression. Visible face outline is softly angular oval with moderate cheekbone width and a gently squared jaw. Neck is medium length; shoulders are narrow-to-medium with a natural relaxed slope. Exact same muted stone-blue crew-neck top in every panel.
Current hair: natural very dark brown chin-to-upper-neck grown-out bob. Near-center natural part. Top and frontal hairline visually lie rather quiet and close, with delicate temple coverage; do not show baldness. Lower sides, behind ears, occipital and nape look more compact and weighty. Outer surface is mostly straight with subtle real flyaways; inner nape has only a faint natural bend, not obvious curls. Face-framing pieces currently reach cheek-to-jaw. Baseline is soft and slightly uneven from grow-out, with ear-tuck memory on both sides. No salon blowout, no teasing, no wet look, no perm, no iron styling, no heavy product.
Style/medium: highly realistic editorial salon documentation photograph, honest skin and hair texture, no beauty filter, no facial reshaping.
Composition/framing: four equal vertical panels in one landscape image. Every panel must show the full crown, complete hair outline and baseline, both ears where the view permits, neck and both shoulders. Profiles are genuine 90-degree side views; back shows no face. Keep identity, head/face proportion, hair length, parting, clothing and lighting consistent across all panels.
Lighting/mood: soft diffused neutral daylight, analytical and clear, no dramatic highlights.
Constraints: no text, labels, arrows, measurements, watermark, accessories, glasses, earrings, hands, tools or extra people. Show only the current hairstyle. The image must not imply measured density, hair diameter, damage grade or future result.
Avoid: makeover comparison, after image, AI reference hairstyle, exaggerated airy crown, inflated occiput, wolf cut, obvious layers, wet look, glamorous styling, synthetic wig texture, cropped crown, cropped shoulders, missing nape, three-quarter profiles, mismatched people or clothing.
